statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(m)-[r:TAGGED]->(:AWSTag) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:ECSCluster)-[:HAS_CONTAINER_INSTANCE|HAS_TASK]->(m)-[r:TAGGED]->(:AWSTag) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:LoadBalancerV2)-[:ELBV2_LISTENER]->(m:ELBV2Listener)-[r:TAGGED]->(:AWSTag) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
MATCH (n:AWSTag) WHERE NOT (n)--() AND n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
